The '''Bak'arap Farmstead''' was  [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]] located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The farmstead were overrun by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:MP" /><ref name="TOR:RR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Raiders’ Reckoning|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Bak'arap Farmstead appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The game map identified the moisture farm as the "Ransacked Bak'arap Farmstead" during the quest "Malicious Persecution."<ref name="TOR:MP" /> However, the mission "Race Against Doom" identified another farm, in the [[Deathly Heat]], as the Bak'arap Farmstead.<ref name="TOR:RAD">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Last One Out|Race Against Doom}}</ref> This is apparently a mistake as the game map identified that other farm as [[Grommik's Residence]].<ref name="TOR:LOO">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Last One Out|Tatooine}}</ref> Accordingly, the description of the mission "Jawa Justice" also identified the farm in the Northern Wastes as the Bak'arap Farmstead.<ref name="TOR:JJ">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Jawa Justice|Tatooine}}</ref>
